label: Whatever lies in a being's nature is contained in the supplied concept of it
paraphrase: OPEN (concept adequacy), analyst formulation: for every being x and world-proposition phi, if it lies in the nature of x that phi (ESSENCE_5), then phi is a determination contained in the supplied concept of x. True by construction of a concept adequate to the nature; false of a concept formed only from a being's effects whenever its nature has content those effects do not give (controls, kantAquinas). The bridge by which Kant's conceptual thesis reaches essential truth (controls, laws 2-3).
